Getting to your hotel in Pitlochry
Directions to Fonab Castle
Fonab Castle is beautifully situated on the banks of Loch Faskally, near Pitlochry in the Scottish Highlands.
By car - For guests arriving by car, take the A9 north from Edinburgh or Glasgow and follow signs to Pitlochry. From there, continue toward Loch Faskally on Foss Road, where you’ll find Fonab Castle.
Parking - Our car park is located at the hotel entrance on a level, tarmac surface. We also have a drop-off point at the front door where our Concierge can assist with unloading luggage.
By train - If you’re traveling by train, Pitlochry Station is a convenient option with regular services from Edinburgh, Glasgow, and Inverness, and it’s only a short taxi ride to our Pitlochry spa hotel.
Frequently Asked Questions
What are the best family-friendly walks and activities near Fonab Castle Hotel?
Fonab Castle Hotel is ideally located for family adventures. A short walk from the hotel brings you to the Pitlochry Dam Visitor Centre and Pitlochry Fish Ladder, providing a great educational experience outdoors for visitors of all ages.
For families seeking a bit more action, the lovely trails around Loch Faskally are perfect for easy strolls, while the nearby Nae Limits Adventure Centre, just a 10-minute drive away, offers exciting activities like white-water rafting and gorge walking for older kids and teenagers.
Are there dog-friendly walking trails starting directly from the hotel?
Yes, our location on the banks of Loch Faskally offers immediate access to beautiful woodland paths. You can enjoy a peaceful riverside walk along the Port-Na-Craig area, which is highly popular with local dog walkers.
For a variety of longer routes, we recommend exploring the Pitlochry Path Network. To see our full pet policy, please visit our dedicated Dog-Friendly Stays page.
How long does it take to walk from Fonab Castle Hotel to Pitlochry town centre?
Fonab Castle Hotel is less than a 30-minute walk from the heart of Pitlochry. The route is picturesque, leading you across the Port-na-Craig footbridge and by the iconic Pitlochry Dam and fish ladder.
This pleasant walk provides convenient access to the town’s shops, cafes, and local attractions while allowing you to enjoy the quiet, secluded setting of the castle grounds.
Are there any off-lead exercise areas for dogs near the hotel?
While much of the local area around Loch Faskally is beautiful for leashed walks, many of the surrounding forest trails in Perthshire are perfect for well-behaved dogs.
We recommend checking local signage at the start of the Killiecrankie or Faskally Wood trails. For specific advice on the best dog-friendly spots in the area, our team is happy to provide recommendations.
What are the best local attractions for a family day trip near Fonab Castle Hotel?
There is a wealth of family activities within a short drive. The Scottish Crannog Centre (approx. 40 minutes away) offers a fascinating, interactive look at Iron Age life on Loch Tay.

How to get here
Directions to Daffodil Hotel & Spa
The Daffodil Hotel & Spa is beautifully located on the shores of Grasmere, just a short drive from Ambleside in the heart of the Lake District.
By car - For those arriving by car and travelling north, take the M6 and exit at Junction 36, travelling south, take the M6 and exit at Junction 40, then follow signs for Ambleside and Grasmere. As you approach Grasmere village, the hotel will be clearly signposted, guiding you along the scenic route to the lakefront.
Parking - Our car park is located at the hotel entrance on a level, tarmac surface. We also have a drop-off point at the front door where we can assist with unloading luggage.
By train - If you’re arriving by train, the nearest station is Windermere, with regular connections from Oxenholme on the main West Coast line. From Windermere, it’s a quick taxi or bus ride to the hotel. We look forward to welcoming you for a relaxing lakeside escape.
Frequently Asked Questions
What family-friendly parks and playgrounds are near The Daffodil Hotel?
The Daffodil Hotel is a fantastic spot for families looking to enjoy nature. A short walk from the hotel takes you to the shores of Lake Grasmere, which offers accessible, flat walking paths perfect for pushchairs.
Additionally, the nearby Allan Bank (National Trust) provides wonderful woodland grounds and natural play spaces for children to explore.
Is The Daffodil Hotel a good base for dog-friendly walks in Grasmere?
Yes, The Daffodil Hotel is an ideal base for dog owners. We are surrounded by some of the most scenic dog-walking routes in the Lake District, including Rydal Cave, a 30-minute walk from the hotel, and Loughrigg Fell.
You can find a curated list of our recommended local routes and tips on our dedicated Dog-Friendly page .
What are the best outdoor activities for families near the hotel?
Families staying with us can enjoy a variety of activities just moments away. Beyond the scenic walks around Lake Grasmere, you can explore the historic Wordsworth Grasmere museum, take a gentle boat cruise on nearby lakes, or enjoy family-friendly cycling routes.
Does The Daffodil Hotel offer family-friendly dining options?
Yes, we welcome families in our dining areas and are happy to accommodate younger guests.
Our menus feature a variety of options designed to suit different tastes, and our team is committed to ensuring a relaxed, comfortable environment for parents and children to enjoy a meal together after a busy day of local exploring.

How to get here
Directions to Dunkeld House Hotel
Dunkeld House Hotel is peacefully set along the River Tay in the heart of Perthshire’s scenic countryside.
By car - Take the A9 toward Dunkeld from either Edinburgh or Glasgow. As you reach Dunkeld, follow the signs for Dunkeld House Hotel, located just minutes from the village, nestled among woodlands and riverside views.
Parking - Our car park is located at the hotel entrance on a level, tarmac surface.
By train - Dunkeld & Birnam Station is nearby, with regular connections from Perth, Edinburgh, and Glasgow. From the station, it’s a short taxi ride to the hotel.
Frequently Asked Questions
Are there family-friendly parks or playgrounds near Dunkeld House Hotel?
Yes, Dunkeld is a fantastic destination for families. Just a short distance from the hotel, you can find the popular Dunkeld Play Park, which features equipment suitable for various ages.
Additionally, the hotel’s own expansive estate offers plenty of safe, open green spaces for children to play, along with easy walking trails perfect for family adventures in nature.
Is Dunkeld House Hotel dog-friendly, and are there good walks nearby?
Absolutely! We love welcoming four-legged guests at Dunkeld House Hotel. Our estate provides miles of beautiful, private woodland, with the option to explore the nearby Pinecone Point or The Hermitage with towering Douglas Firs of Big Tree Country.
For more information on our pet policy, amenities for your pup, and to book your stay, please visit our dedicated Dog-Friendly Hotel page.
What are the best local woodland walks within walking distance of the hotel?
Dunkeld House Hotel is your gateway to some of the most beautiful scenery in Perthshire. Directly from the hotel grounds, you can stroll along the peaceful River Tay or dive into the nearby woodlands.
There are some great local walks, including a trip to the historic Dunkeld Cathedral and the Hermitage, which boasts towering Douglas firs and a stunning waterfall - all just a short walk away.
Are there outdoor activities suitable for children near the hotel?
Beyond local parks, families frequently enjoy exploring the gentle trails around the Loch of the Lowes (famous for its ospreys), taking scenic riverside strolls, and participating in seasonal outdoor activities organised in the village.
Whether you are looking for a gentle family hike or a day out in nature, our team is happy to recommend the best local spots for your family.
Can I walk from the hotel to the village of Dunkeld?
Yes, you can reach the charming village of Dunkeld with a pleasant, scenic walk from the hotel grounds. It is a wonderful way to enjoy the fresh air and see the local landscape before exploring the village's independent shops, cafes, and historic cathedral.
If you have a dog with you, it’s also a great way to get some exercise before relaxing back at the hotel - learn more about our dog-friendly offerings .

How to get here
Directions to Golf View Hotel
Nairn is situated on the A96, 15 miles east of Inverness and 80 miles west of Aberdeen.
By car - From the direction of Inverness, turn left from the A96 at Nairn Old Parish Church and onto Seabank Road which leads to Golf View as the last building on the right.
On approaching Nairn from the east, drive through the town centre on the A96 until you see the Parish Church on the right hand side. Turn right here into Seabank Road and follow the road down towards the sea where Golf View is located on the right hand side.-
Parking - We offer free on-site car parking for up to 30 guest cars.
Frequently Asked Questions
What are the best family-friendly parks and playgrounds near Golf View Hotel & Spa?
Families staying at our hotel can enjoy easy access to Nairn Central Beach, which is around 20 minutes away, and the Nairn West Beach (around a 5-minute walk) that’s perfect for seaside play.
Additionally, the town of Nairn offers several nearby green spaces, such as The Links, which provides open areas for children to run, and the Nairn Museum nearby, which offers engaging local history exhibits for families looking for an indoor activity.
What are the top local dog walks near the hotel?
Some of our favourite local dog walks include Cawdor Castle’s dog-friendly trails & gardens, Nairn Beach, Loch Ness, Urquhart Castle Ruins, Culloden Battlefield & the Clava Cairns.
For longer adventures, the East Beach to Kingsteps walk offers beautiful coastal views. You can find more details on these routes on our dedicated Dog-Friendly page .
How far is Golf View Hotel & Spa from the beach?
Golf View Hotel & Spa boasts a prime beachfront location. We are a 5-minute walk from the golden sands of Nairn West Beach. Guests can enjoy direct access from our gardens to the shore, making it effortless to enjoy a morning stroll or a relaxing day by the Moray Firth.
What is there to do in Nairn for families within walking distance?
Within walking distance, families can walk into Nairn town centre (approx. 20 minutes) to visit the Nairn Museum, explore local independent shops, or play a round of family-friendly golf.
The area is also famous for its dolphin spotting opportunities along the Moray Firth, which can often be seen from the coastline near the hotel.
